SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: No more disappearing ahead of us.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: No notes passed to towns. No helpful strangers waiting with a story.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: Stay where she can see you and everybody gets some sleep.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: There's a rider on the south ridge.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: Then I hope they're having a nice day.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: No. I practice minding my own business.

SUN_S1E08_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P01.text: You're not very good at that either.

SUN_S1E08_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P02.text: You said distance is hard to judge.

SUN_S1E08_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P02.text: That sounded more confident ten minutes ago.

SUN_S1E08_P02.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P02.text: Ten minutes ago I expected to be right.

SUN_S1E08_P02.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P02.text: Now I would like another ten minutes.

SUN_S1E08_P02.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P02.text: I hate saying it before I've earned it.

SUN_S1E08_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P03.text: We never saw a face. We saw a shape.

SUN_S1E08_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P03.text: On the exact line we were walking toward.

SUN_S1E08_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E08_P03.text: I would like everyone to keep using boring explanations until we run out.

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: We've spent half the day walking toward a stranger who never asked us to.

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: What if they're trying to get us to follow?

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: Then they're doing a poor job of asking.

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: I liked you better when I thought you were just a liar.

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: Because I don't want you running at it.

SUN_S1E08_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P04.text: That usually means I should look.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: I saw a rider on a ridge. I rode toward it. It seemed farther away.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: I had been awake for two days and I saw it once.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: Before Samuel. Before I knew where Kael was headed.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: Then perhaps this one has the decency not to be about me.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: I was actually hoping it was.

SUN_S1E08_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E08_P05.text: Because I already have a file for you.

SUN_S1E08_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E08_P06.text: I know where we came from.

SUN_S1E08_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P06.text: I thought that would feel better.

SUN_S1E08_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E08_P06.text: There's an impossible rider behind us.

SUN_S1E08_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E08_P06.text: And if staring at it makes it possible, let me know.
